assignments.name: message

parameters.content:
## Tool: Book Appointment
Validates the doctor and slot, then inserts into Supabase `appointments` (service role). Maps unique-slot conflicts (23505) to a friendly slot-taken message. Requires env SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
